name: THE ULTIMATE FISH STICK
ingredientsText: fish (Alaska pollock), brown rice flour, vegetable oil (soybean and/or canola), whole grain yellow corn flour, sorghum flour, water, modified corn starch, contains 2% or less of: sugar, salt, leavening (sodium acid pyrophosphate, sodium bicarbonate, monocalcium phosphate), yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, spice, extractives of paprika, extractives of turmeric
notes: 'vegetable oil (soybean and/or canola)' makes soy possible. Brown rice and sorghum flour are not wheat.
